disease_label_per_paper: Takayasu retinopathy unveiling underlying Takayasu arteritis
presentation_summary: Nine months of progressive bilateral blurring of vision, worse in the left eye.
Systemic symptoms included presyncope and left upper-limb claudication.
Exam showed absent brachial and radial pulses bilaterally, carotid bruit, and inter-arm BP difference.
CTA showed diffuse mural thickening of the aorta and near-total occlusion of common carotid, internal carotid, external carotid, subclavian, and left vertebral arteries.
CRP was 15 mg/dL and ANA was negative.
